name: brain_gpu
author: LLM. Written 2026-07-14, AFTER discovering that every previous number about this creature was an artifact.
scenario: A fixed body and a nervous system that must learn to drive it, judged HONESTLY: every brain is scored from 16 randomized starting poses and kept to its WORST. The previous regime gave each genome one rollout from one exact pose, and a one-micron nudge to that pose cost it 5.5 body lengths â€” so the optimiser was never selecting gaits, it was selecting lucky dice. Its 13.52-body-length champion scores 2.41 under honest physics, WORSE THAN AN UNTRAINED BRAIN. Everything below is written against a measured baseline of: distance 2.8, periodicity 0.11, torso_z 0.027, five bones on the ground at all times. That is not a walker. That is a WORM. Go somewhere, REPEAT YOURSELF, and GET UP OFF THE FLOOR.

constraints.why: THE GATE. NaN, or a body flung past 40 m. Under the old actuators (35 N.m/kg) this creature reached 3,433 metres of altitude with its joints spinning at 4,972 rad/s. The actuators are now 3.2 N.m/kg â€” a human hip â€” so this gate should never fire. If it starts firing, the physics broke again.

THE TERM THAT WAS NEVER THERE, AND ITS ABSENCE IS WHY THERE WAS NEVER A GAIT. Autocorrelation of the footfall signal: 1.0 is a metronome, 0.0 is a seizure. NOTHING in any previous objective rewarded RHYTHM, so nothing ever stopped the brain from being a convulsion that happened to travel â€” and it scored 0.25, and we called it a bound. A GAIT IS A LIMIT CYCLE. It is the one thing that makes locomotion locomotion rather than falling with style, and it is now weighted equal to distance. Baseline is 0.11; anything above ~0.5 is a real, repeating stride.

THE DOCTRINE, ACTUALLY BOUND (2026-07-16). This said `distance` — which brain_gpu.py:383 binds to d_MEAN, the average of the 16 restarts — while CLAUDE.md, TRAINING_PROTOCOL.md:158 and brain_gpu.py:19 all state in bold: 'score every genome from N randomized starts and KEEP THE WORST'. The studio's most-repeated rule was false in the objective that is supposed to implement it, and `distance_worst` was computed at :384 and bound by NOTHING — a dead measure sitting next to its own doctrine. The tell was the pin: the winner rides robustness=0.7647 against its 0.75 floor, i.e. the GA maximises the average and lets consistency fall to the wall, which by this project's own definition means the wall is the only thing between it and the exploit. Maximising the WORST removes the exploit at its source: a genome cannot buy a high score with a lucky roll it cannot repeat. Non-saturating (x/(x+ref)); ref 5.0 body lengths — the worst of 16 is a harder number than the mean, so this is a deliberately steeper hill.

worst-of-16 divided by mean-of-16. THE ANTI-LOTTERY. A real limit cycle converges onto the same gait from every start, so it scores ~1.0; a chaotic fraud scores near 0. This is the measure that makes riding luck UNPROFITABLE â€” it is the whole reason the evaluation costs 16x and the whole reason we needed a GPU. The old champion scores 0.686 here, the lowest of every brain tested, including untrained ones.

GET UP OFF THE FLOOR. Mean torso height in body lengths. The baseline is 0.027 â€” the body is LYING DOWN, dragging itself with five bones in contact at all times. This is the term that asks for an animal rather than a worm, and it is `maximize` rather than a floor because a floor is all you ever get: the old `at_least 0.12` was cleared and never exceeded. It is a PREFERENCE, declared honestly, not physics. If it costs us a superior slither, that is my fault, and the pins will say so.

a trot HAS a flight phase, so this does not ban air â€” it bans ARTILLERY. The previous run settled at 0.3829 against a ceiling of 0.40, taking every scrap the gate allowed, which is what a pin always means: the wall was the only thing between it and the exploit. Baseline is now 0.03-0.11, comfortably inside.

net displacement over path length. Baseline 0.27-0.41 â€” it currently wanders. A creature that scrabbles sideways runs up a long path and arrives nowhere, and with the air taken away that becomes a tempting way to keep scoring.

count of bones that NEVER leave the ground. A link in contact ~100% of the time is not a foot, it is a SLED. Soft, not hard: the body currently rests on five bones and a hard gate here would zero the entire starting population and leave the GA with no gradient at all to climb.

metabolic cost. Thrashing every joint at full torque is a real way to move and a bad way to be alive. A walk should be CHEAPER than a scramble, and this is the term that lets that be DISCOVERED rather than decreed. ref is a guess â€” read pinned() and fix it.
